findings.summary: Unrelated Python reformat of the sent_rows list comprehension landed in the labour-clock step-0 range; it is outside this step's scope.
findings.suggestion: Split into its own style commit in a follow-up, or leave as-is. Does not affect the labour tests. Rebuttal accepted as non-blocking.

findings.summary: PEOPLE employment_type and rate_basis are stored without validation, so a typo (e.g. 'Casual ') only surfaces later as a 'no multiplier' throw from labourMultiplier_ rather than at config-read time.
findings.suggestion: Optionally validate employment_type in {casual, full_time, part_time} and rate_basis in {loaded, unloaded, any} in labourReadConfig_ in a later step. Not on the step-0 test list, so not blocking.
